test_name: Awareness and Training - AT-6 Fully Implemented
architecture:
System: Case-Management-016
Primary NIST family: Awareness and Training (AT); evidence focus: AT-6.
Environment: GCP. Network access uses Private Service Connect; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a customer-managed Cloud KMS key. Control evidence: annual security and privacy literacy training is current for employees and contractors. No exceptions, overdue findings, plaintext channels, public databases, or privileged-authentication gaps are reported.
